LoadLeakage queries Waste/Spoilage/Breakage StockMovements by CreatedAtUtc in [start,end), projects nullable LossValuePiastres, sums null as zero but returns losses.Count separately; it composes SalesReport values for offers/comps/manual discounts/refunds plus the passed expenses (lines 175-183). No specific existing test asserting null loss handling was found in this batch; no evidence of a mutation error.

custody_settlement_disposition.question: SettleDriverCustodyHandler marks every custody row SettledPiastres=CollectedPiastres even when aggregate Actual differs or is zero. Is this a confirmed financial inconsistency?
custody_settlement_disposition.disposition: SOURCE_CONFIRMED_PER_ROW_VS_AGGREGATE_REPRESENTATIONAL_DIVERGENCE; PER_ROW_FIELD_SEMANTICS_UNRESOLVED; do not promote to confirmed accounting defect without owner policy.

source_evidence.behavior: Aggregate expected is sum of CollectedPiastres and actual comes from request; difference requires reason plus settlement approval.
A Posted treasury movement is written only when actual is positive, for aggregate actual amount.
Every selected row is marked Settled and each SettledPiastres is copied from that row’s CollectedPiastres, regardless of aggregate difference.
DriverSettlement separately persists aggregate Expected, Actual, Difference, treasury movement reference.
Expected explicitly sums Collected from unsettled custody; aggregate difference is actual minus expected.
One custody row per delivery, with Expected/Collected/Settled/Difference fields; no XML comment defines SettledPiastres as physical cash allocation.
Collected is set from actual collection or expected; variance gets a reason; custody row records collected and difference versus expected.
Current unsettled cash custody sums CollectedPiastres; historical account summarizes aggregate DriverSettlement actual, not per-custody SettledPiastres.
API exposes aggregate settlement expected/actual/difference and current CashCustodyPiastres; not per-row settled allocation.
Business-day expected driver cash sums Collected of unsettled rows; settled cash derives Posted aggregate driver_settlement treasury movement.
Prefills actual from aggregate current CashCustodyPiastres and calculates difference against that aggregate.
Labels aggregate CashCustodyPiastres as cash custody due; no per-row SettledPiastres presentation.

counterevidence: The aggregate DriverSettlement explicitly stores actual and shortage/overage difference; positive actual is the treasury amount, while zero actual creates no positive movement.
UI and account/report consumers in inspected paths reason about aggregate Collected due versus aggregate actual; none inspected consumes per-row SettledPiastres.

DeliveryRulesTests verifies aggregate expected/difference, and DeliveryVerticalSliceTests verifies equal settlement and aggregate shortage authorization, but neither asserts per-custody SettledPiastres in shortage/zero cases.
custody_settlement_disposition.interpretation: If SettledPiastres means amount physically allocated from the handed-in actual to this delivery, the copied Collected amount is inconsistent whenever actual differs from aggregate collected (including zero actual). If it means the original per-delivery collected custody amount that was operationally closed, with actual shortage/overage tracked only by DriverSettlement aggregate, it may be intentional. Current consumers do not resolve that domain meaning.
custody_settlement_disposition.owner_confirmation_needed: Define whether per-row SettledPiastres is (a) original collected amount whose custody case is closed, or (b) actual cash allocation received for that delivery. If (b), specify deterministic allocation for shortages/overages/zero; do not invent allocation. If (a), document explicitly.
validation_needed: Add handler/integration tests with two custody rows and aggregate actual equal to neither row sum nor zero; assert aggregate settlement/till movement and each row value.
Add zero-actual approval test asserting no positive treasury movement and intended per-row settled value.
Add domain/report reconciliation test proving sum of per-row SettledPiastres is or is not expected to equal aggregate ActualPiastres according to owner policy.
